How to Understand It

The 12+6 Canonical Theory & Proof Assistant Variants (Directive 12):

Every .nbg file and formal development specifies its target theory and proof assistant variant at the top of the file. The default theory is MKTD = Morse-Kelley + Tarski + Dunaev (Morse-Kelley impredicative class theory + Tarski's Axiom of Universes + Dunaev's refined axioms and explicit quotation/antiquotation, encoding/decoding, embedding, and conglomerate types):

  • Variant 1 (1st-Order Syntactical Proof Assistant, suffix 1): NBG1, NBGT1, NBGTD1, MK1, MKT1, MKTD1 (Default Variant 1).
  • Variant 2 (Higher-Order Formulas-as-Types Proof Assistant, suffix 2): NBG2, NBGT2, NBGTD2, MK2, MKT2, MKTD2 (Default Variant 2).
  • Shared / Dual-Variant Reserved Identifiers (suffix *): NBG*, NBGT*, NBGTD*, MK*, MKT*, MKTD*.
  • Metatheoretic Theory Variables (𝒯, ℱ, ℰ, 𝒲): In Section 5 (Entries ThmLoeb (5.01)–ThmSecondIncompleteness (5.02)), ℰ ranges over any sufficiently strong formal theory extending IΣ₁ (such as PA, NBG, MK, or MKTD).
